scope: synthetic OIDC and DNS fixtures; real isolated PostgreSQL, compiled API and production Next browser
privateWorkerRecovery: Covered separately by activation service tests; no live worker is run here

checks.name: new controls require explicit current platform roles, never owner or token claims
suspend and resume invalidate old bearer, peer receipt and stale browser authority
owner lifecycle preserves IDs and refuses cross-owner, active and stale mutations
activation jobs require current independent approval and never activate at enqueue
revoked reviewer and edited requests cannot reuse an existing activation approval
new protected pages deny anonymous users and render privately at narrow and wide widths
native person controls enforce confirmation, CSRF and stale-token refusal after re-enable
native owner forms edit, cancel and resubmit without reusing earlier proof
native activation queues exact reviewed configuration and displays pending private work
current role revocation removes authority from existing operator browser sessions
round-2 browser routes have no hydration or runtime page errors
